Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

job_title: Data Quality Engineer - Remote in Canada
location: Halifax,NS-6940 Mumford Rd, Nova Scotia, Canada
description: Data Quality Engineer As a Data Quality Engineer specializing in Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity at Cognizant, you will design and execute automated data validation across extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes, data warehouses, and data migrations. You will work with development and data engineering teams to verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source and target systems. This is a full-time, remote role open only to candidates located in Canada. Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data integrity checks, using SQL queries to validate transformations and load processes. Log, track, and retest defects in partnership with development and data engineering teams. Collaborate with onshore and offshore teams to deliver testing activities and prepare test execution reports and knowledge-transfer documentation. Provide regular status updates, identify risks, and support production validation activities. Strong experience in ETL, data warehouse, and data migration testing, including validation across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Hands-on SQL query writing and database testing experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or DB2. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and data integrity testing. Ability to analyze business requirements, data models, mapping documents, and technical specifications and translate them into test plans and test cases. Experience with test execution and defect management using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments and an onshore-offshore delivery model, with effective cross-functional collaboration. Job summary Sr Business Analyst role focused on analyzing complex business processes translating stakeholder needs into clear requirements and driving impactful solutions that align with organizational strategy. The role involves hybrid work with day shifts collaborating across teams to improve performance optimize operations and enable data informed decisions while ensuring consistent delivery quality and sustainable value. Responsibilities Analyze diverse business processes and stakeholder objectives to identify improvement opportunities that enhance operational efficiency and support strategic organizational goals. Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather detailed business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation. Document current and future state workflows with precise process maps and narratives that help stakeholders understand impacts dependencies and required changes. Evaluate potential solution options using structured analysis techniques and recommend approaches that balance business value feasibility and long term sustainability. Facilitate requirement walkthroughs and feedback sessions with stakeholders to confirm shared understanding resolve ambiguities and secure alignment on scope and priorities. Support development and configuration activities by clarifying requirements answering business context questions and validating proposed technical designs against business needs. Design comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance criteria that verify end to end coverage of requirements and enable robust user acceptance testing outcomes. Analyze data and performance metrics from implemented solutions to measure value realization identify gaps or issues and propose improvements that refine business outcomes. Prepare clear status reports and analytic summaries that communicate progress risks and insights to stakeholders in a concise and actionable format. Coordinate hybrid working interactions by planning onsite and remote collaboration sessions that maintain productivity inclusiveness and timely decision making. Ensure compliance with internal standards and industry regulations in all analysis deliverables so that solutions are secure ethical and aligned to societal expectations. Contribute to knowledge sharing by creating reusable templates guidelines and best practice documentation that strengthen the business analysis capability across the company. Partner with business and technology teams to ensure that implemented solutions improve customer and employee experiences and positively impact broader communities. Qualifications Apply deep business analysis expertise gained from eight to ten years of experience to interpret complex stakeholder needs and convert them into structured requirements. Demonstrate strong proficiency in business analysis practices and business analysis and planning disciplines such as process modeling requirements elicitation and impac
